summary: Simethicone is an over-the-counter antiflatulent that relieves the pressure, bloating and fullness caused by excess gastrointestinal gas. It is not absorbed systemically and works by coalescing gas bubbles. Usual adult dosing is 40-125 mg after meals and at bedtime, not exceeding the labeled daily maximum.
indications: Relief of pressure, bloating and fullness commonly referred to as gas
Symptomatic relief of excess gastrointestinal gas (flatulence)
Adjunct to reduce gas/foam before certain endoscopic or radiographic GI procedures

moa: Simethicone is an inert silicone-based surfactant (a mixture of polydimethylsiloxane and silica gel) that acts as a defoaming agent. It lowers the surface tension of gas bubbles trapped in mucus in the gastrointestinal tract, causing them to coalesce into larger bubbles that are more easily eliminated by belching or passing flatus. It is not absorbed and has no systemic pharmacologic action.

absolute: Known hypersensitivity to simethicone or formulation components
relative: Suspected mechanical bowel obstruction (gas may signal other pathology)
monitor: Persistent or worsening abdominal symptoms (evaluate for underlying cause)

preg: Simethicone is not absorbed from the gastrointestinal tract and is considered safe for use during pregnancy when symptomatic relief of gas is needed.
lact: Simethicone is not absorbed systemically and is not expected to pass into breast milk; it is considered compatible with breastfeeding.
renal: No dosage adjustment required; simethicone is not absorbed and not eliminated renally.
hepatic: No dosage adjustment required; simethicone is not absorbed and not metabolized hepatically.

missed: Simethicone is taken as needed; if a scheduled dose is missed, take it when remembered or simply take the next dose as needed. Do not double the dose or exceed the daily maximum.
overdose: Overdose is not expected to cause toxicity because simethicone is not absorbed. Excess may cause mild gastrointestinal upset; treat symptomatically.
